name: MONKA G995W
author: Piotr Cichowlas
description: Battery, DPI stages, polling rate and lighting controls for the MONKA G995W wireless mouse over 2.4 GHz, Bluetooth or USB-C, using its vendor HID and BLE reports.

barWidget.description: Shows the MONKA G995W mouse battery in the bar, warns near 10%, and controls DPI stages, polling rate and lighting from the panel over 2.4 GHz, Bluetooth or USB-C.

schema.label: Low battery warning (%)
schema.description: Send one notification when the mouse reaches this percentage while discharging.

schema.label: Refresh interval (seconds)
schema.description: How often to read the mouse status report. The mouse sends one about every two seconds.
